resticCandidate.scope: Notice-file collection for exact Linux ARM64 candidate: 79 module source sums matched binary metadata, upstream restic 0.19.1 plus its module-only patch, and Go 1.26.8 compiler/runtime distribution. Includes nested notices and compiler source notices; not a completed legal or platform distribution audit. Identical notice texts share a hash; each source file retains attribution here. The Linux x86-64 candidate has the same 79 module path/version/checksum triples and compiler version; its hash is recorded separately.
